Casey (AE): Quick - Prospect asks for SOC2 excerpt, signed pen-test attestation, and a private dataroom for POC artifacts. Also wants to know if a 2-week Dedicated pilot changes billing. Need ~48h turnaround.

Nina S: We can provide a redacted SOC2 PDF and our pen-test attestation template. Signed letter requires NDA + named signatory (name/title/email). We won't share raw scan outputs or keys.

Devon (Security): Dataroom intake form: https://redwood.example.com/assurance/dataroom-request. Include TTL, contact, NDA. KMS diagrams OK if redacted (no IPs/keys). Access logging/watermarking enabled. If they ask for full vuln reports escalate to legal.

FinOps Bot: Hosted POC = free credits/pay-as-you-go. Dedicated pilot requires a reserved pool and signed commit; finance can prorate but needs approval for <30d. I can produce a 2-week provisional quote in ~2h.

Casey (AE): Thanks - I'll request NDA/signatory now and loop in procurement. Please drop the Dedicated estimate in this thread.

Devon (Security): Creating ticket SEC-2026-999 for dataroom provisioning. ETA 1 business day after intake + NDA.
